patch_description: This crossover preserves the proven collective RY–CZ structure while removing the collective RZ layer. The remaining RY rotations do not commute with the CZ entanglers, so six independently parameterized repetitions still provide nontrivial trainable dynamics. This reduces the circuit from two parameters to one parameter per block, lowering the total from 14 to 8 trainable parameters, while also reducing gate count and depth. The fixed training, data preparation, repetitions, measurements, and outputs remain unchanged.
